env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only to let Lake resolve the pinned Lean toolchain before isolated Lean replay
env_allowlist.PATH: sanitized variable; resolved Python, Git, Bash, timeout, Bubblewrap, Lean, and Lake identities are digest-checked by the receipt

network_enforcement: The checker invokes check_validation.sh, which places every Lean subprocess in its own Bubblewrap network namespace with read-only host mounts and a private writable output directory. The checker itself performs only repo-local reconciliation subprocesses and no network operation. Lean uses fixed locale/timezone/umask/thread count and disposable output space. The existing pinned shared warm dependency closure is read only, so this is deliberately nonrelease evidence rather than a cold empty-cache reproduction.
scope_boundary: This recipe independently replays every vendored source module, the exact statement, the frozen conditional composition, the exact proof root, and transitive placeholder/axiom probes, then validates only the negative release verdict. It cannot provide validation master acceptance, reconcile the alternate proof route with the frozen graph, accept a foundation profile or complete source/readability/trust closure, perform a cold offline build, supply-chain archive, independent attestations, minimal verifier, protected CI, deterministic release bundle, or master acceptance.
